text:
Maya Gupta: Hi team! I’m Maya, joining Platform as a backend infra engineer. Remote (PST) first day. My Windows laptop popped an Intune enrollment prompt but I never got an invite email. Who should I ping?

Owen (People Ops): Welcome Maya!! :tada: Tagging IT. Also check the onboarding form for shipping prefs.

Rene (IT): Hey Maya 
I sent an Intune enrollment link to maya.gupta@redwood.ai. Check spam and promotions. If nothing shows, tell me the device serial and I’ll push a manual provisioning token. After you accept run:
```powershell
# verify Intune enrollment
Get-MDMEnrollmentStatus
```

Maya Gupta: Thanks Rene. No email in spam. Serial: WDFY12345.

Rene (IT): Got it 
Manual token applied, re-send going out.

onboard-bot: Provisioning event: user maya.gupta created; Slack channels: #platform,#new-hires; GitHub team: platform-backend.

Maya Gupta: Intune enrolled and shows compliant. Now hitting `Permission denied (publickey)` when SSH-ing to bastion. I added my key to the onboarding repo under my github handle but maybe formatted incorrectly.

Lars (Platform): Welcome! Make sure the key is a single-line `ssh-ed25519` (or rsa) and filename is `maya_gupta.pub`. If it's there already, @ops-bot can run the sync.

ops-bot: SSH key sync queued for maya.gupta.

ops-bot: SSH key sync complete  keys propagated to jump hosts.

Maya Gupta: SSH works now, thank you. Quick access Q: I need read access to the hermes-infra private repo for the bootstrap scripts. Who grants that?

Lars (Platform): File a PR to infra-access with the repo and reason, or ping me and I’ll approve. Also join the weekly platform sync on Thursdays.

Nina (Security): Welcome Maya. Please enroll in MFA and request a YubiKey if you want hardware 2FA (ops-ticket #2044). Also run `gci -Path C:\Users\$env:USERNAME\.ssh` to confirm no stray keys.

Maya Gupta: Will do. Fun fact: I coach youth soccer on weekends. Looking forward to pairing later today!

Owen (People Ops): Welcome pack (hoodie + stickers) is on the way. We have a local SF lunch crew in #random if you want to join.

Lars (Platform): I’ll schedule a 45m buddy session at 3pm PST to walk through the bootstrap and on-call runbooks.

Maya Gupta: Awesome, see you then 331 :soccer: :sparkles:
